comingLast.roast: a 30-handicapper on 23 - even the extra shots could not save the day
5 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
4 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
one decent hole (6 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Owens
at 1.4 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
needs 2 points from his last 3 to hand the blue balls to Owens
